Located just 400 meters from one of Europe's most iconic beaches for kitesurfing, this campsite is perfect for disconnecting and experiencing Tarifa at your own pace. class="room_content"><div class="top_content" style><div class="content_title 2" style><h3 class="title"> Medium Pitches </h3></div><div class="filter_tabs owl-carousel" style><div class="tab active" data-filter="Terrace" data-index="1"> Terrace </div><div class="tab" data-filter="Sunlit_terrace" data-index="2"> Sunlit terrace </div><div class="tab" data-filter="Median" data-index="3"> Median </div><div class="tab" data-filter="With_sun" data-index="4"> With sun </div></div></div><div class="desc_carousel owl-carousel"><div class="desc_wrapper" style><div class="desc"> If you're looking for a practical getaway surrounded by nature, this pitch is for you. You can also rent rackets and balls at the reception.<br> Nature, sport, and a great atmosphere... the perfect match.<br><br><br></div><div class="links_wrapper" style></div></div></div></div><div class="service_item" data-hash="facilities_service_6" style><div class="picture_wrapper owl-carousel"><div class="img_wrapper" style><img alt="Taiga: Corporate, modern sinks with marble dividers and round mirrors." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/2d0612561af2935" loading="lazy"></div><div class="img_wrapper" style><img alt="Taiga: Corporate bathrooms with showers and blue and white tiles." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/7bee53a3d9bfb6b" loading="lazy"></div><div class="img_wrapper" style><img alt="Accessible bathroom Taiga: shower, toilet, and fold-down seat." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/db5ec9331bf7d6b" loading="lazy"></div><div class="img_wrapper" style><img alt="Taiga: Corporate - Outdoor white and blue tiled sinks." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/e404ce28a1f5a1d" loading="lazy"></div><div class="img_wrapper" style><img alt="Taiga: Corporativa - Bathroom with sinks and round mirrors, blue tiles." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/e3419d9c16e9871" loading="lazy"></div><div class="img_wrapper" style><img alt="Modern white Taiga: Corporativa building with lush green trees." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/98ec23f889fba01" loading="lazy"></div></div><div class="content_wrapper"><div class="inner_content"><div class="content_title"><h4 class="title"> Restrooms </h4></div><div class="desc"> 3 sanitary blocks completely renovated this year 2026 distributed throughout the campsite, with hot water showers, sinks and toilets. Cleaned several times a day and with a specific area for washing dishes and clothes. They also have space adapted for people with reduced mobility and a baby area. </div><div class="links_wrapper" style></div></div></div></div></div></div><section class="banner_carousel_wrapper" data-filter><div class="container12" style><div class="title_wrapper"><h2 class="title"><a>What experience </a> do you want to have? </h2></div><div class="content_wrapper"><div class="filters"><div class="filter" data-trigger="0"> Kite Surf and Wind Foil </div><div class="filter" data-trigger="1"> Horseback riding route through the Estrecho Natural Park </div><div class="filter" data-trigger="2"> Whale watching </div><div class="filter" data-trigger="3"> Diving Course in Tarifa </div><div class="filter" data-trigger="4"> Bike rental </div><div class="filter active all" data-trigger="0"> All </div></div><div class="carousel_wrapper"><div class="carousel owl-carousel" style><div class="item" data-item="Kite Surf and Wind Foil" style><div class="image"><img alt="Taiga Kitesurf: Corporate experience in Tarifa with orange kite and students on the beach." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/8a34aaef93e1b34"><div class="gradient_img"></div></div><div class="name_item"> Kite Surf and Wind Foil <div class="desc_item"><div class="desc"> Practice kitesurfing and wind foiling on one of the best beaches in the world, with constant Levante wind and kilometers of sand to learn or sail at your own pace. </div><a class="btn_more" href="kite-surf-and-wind-foil-at-taiga-valdevaqueros.html" title="See more">See more</a></div></div></div><div class="item" data-item="Horseback riding route through the Estrecho Natural Park" style><div class="image"><img alt="Beach horseback riding, Taiga Corporativa." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/a8cea95818e1ae7"><div class="gradient_img"></div></div><div class="name_item"> Horseback riding route through the Estrecho Natural Park <div class="desc_item"><div class="desc"> Reservations must be made at our reception desk, and we will be happy to arrange it for you. Immerse yourself in nature and enjoy a unique experience with our horseback riding tour in Conil. This activity is perfect for disconnecting and reconnecting with the surroundings. An experience that combines tranquility, nature, and adventure, ideal for the whole family. </div><a class="btn_more" href="horseback-riding-route-through-the-estrecho-natural-park.html" title="See more">See more</a></div></div></div><div class="item" data-item="Whale watching" style><div class="image"><img alt="Taiga: Corporativa. Dolphins swimming in blue waters, a serene scene." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/993821fbe012aac"><div class="gradient_img"></div></div><div class="name_item"> Whale watching <div class="desc_item"><div class="desc"> Enjoy an unforgettable whale-watching experience with departures from the Port of Tarifa. </div><a class="btn_more" href="whale-watching.html" title="See more">See more</a></div></div></div><div class="item" data-item="Diving Course in Tarifa" style><div class="image"><img alt="Divers exploring seabed, perfect for Taiga Corporativa events." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/ab92d0077eb3e68"><div class="gradient_img"></div></div><div class="name_item"> Diving Course in Tarifa <div class="desc_item"><div class="desc"> If you've ever dreamed of floating among fish, reefs, and hidden underwater secrets, this is your moment. Whether you're a beginner or looking for a more complete experience, a fascinating world beneath the waves awaits. </div><a class="btn_more" href="diving-course-in-tarifa.html" title="See more">See more</a></div></div></div><div class="item" data-item="Bike rental" style><div class="image"><img alt="Couple cycling under the sun, perfect for Taiga: Corporativa getaways." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/q10-corpo/images/496e06b6a3e5129"><div class="gradient_img"></div></div><div class="name_item"> Bike rental <div class="desc_item"><div class="desc"> Enjoy the freedom and pleasure of exploring all the corners of Conil and its beautiful beaches with our touring bicycles. Whether you want to tour the picturesque town center, discover hidden paths or simply pedal along the sea. </div><a class="btn_more" href="bike-rentals-in-taiga.html" title="See more">See more</a></div></div></div></div></div></div><input class="animate_appearance" type="hidden" value></div></section><div class="banner_download_buttons" data-filter style><div class="container12" style><div class="banner" style><a href="experiences.html" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title><i></i><b> All experiences</b></a></div></div></div><div class="banner_cycle_wrapper" id="banner_283" style></div><div class="banner_download_buttons" data-filter><div class="container12" style><div class="banner" style><a href="experiences.html" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title><i></i><b> All experiences</b></a></div></div></div><div class="banner_full_carousel_wrapper" id="activities"><div class="container12" style><div class="top_banner"><div class="content_title" id="descubre" style><h3 class="title"> Discover <b>Tarifa</b></h3></div><div class="desc"> This is the perfect spot where relaxation, adventure, and nature coexist in harmony. Located just 400 meters from one of Europe's most iconic kitesurfing beaches, this campsite is perfect for unwinding and experiencing Tarifa at your own pace. Here you can pitch your tent among the trees, bring your campervan, or relax in our accommodations, all in the heart of the Estrecho Natural Park. </div></div></div><div class="container" style><div class="gallery_wrapper"><div class="item_wrapper"><div class="picture_wrapper"><img alt="Golden sand dunes with wooden fences, blue sea and clear sky, perfect for Taiga: Corporate." class="lazyload" data-src="https://cdn2.paraty.es/taiga-test/images/c9b5e065ab61f85"></div><div class="item_content"><div class="content_title" style><h4 class="title"> What to see and do in Valdevaqueros </h4></div><div class="content_wrapper"><div class="desc"> Known as one of Europe's best spots, Valdevaqueros is a paradise for kitesurfing and windsurfing. Its constant wind conditions and vast expanse of sand make it ideal for both experienced riders and beginners.<br><br> If flying isn't your thing, that's fine: lying in the sun and looking up at the comet-filled sky is also part of the magic.<br><br> One of the most iconic images of the area. This giant dune has been formed by the force of the easterly wind, and climbing it (although it's steep) is well worth it. From the top, the views of the beach, the sea, and the pine forests are breathtaking.<br><br> Just a few minutes' drive from TAIGA Tarifa Valevaqueros, you'll find the strait's viewpoint, which offers breathtaking views: the Moroccan mountains, the intense blue of the Strait of Gibraltar, and the silhouettes of Tarifa and Valdevaqueros merging into the horizon. A place to stop, breathe... and take a thousand photos. </div><div class="links_wrapper" style><a class="see_more" href="/en/what-to-see-and-do-in-valdevaqueros.html"> See more </a><a class="button-promotion" href="#data">Book here</a></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="buttons_links_wrapper" data-filter data-scroll-trigger style></div><div
